description: Tier-0 ${for…lift} per-item if= STRUCTURAL absence at CREATE time (SPEC §17.1) — the for-lift sibling of the Tier-1 <each> fix. Two reconciled rows keyed by id; id=2 seeds on:false, so its <li> is NOT in the DOM at first paint (removed, not display:none). Pins the create-time absence half: a false row leaves only a <!--scrml-if-row--> comment placeholder, so .row count is 1 not 2.
rationale: §17.1 an if=false per-item element does not exist in the DOM. The Tier-0 for-lift path used to lower if= to a display toggle (element present, display:none) — a §17.1 violation. The structural swap emits the element OR a comment placeholder as the sole tracked node, so with no reactive input the create-time state yields exactly one .row (Alice); Bob is absent. domAnchored COUNT (not whole-tree dom) because a false row leaves a comment placeholder.
